annotations.title: Rename a website, app, agent, or skill

description: Rename a website, app, agent, or skill. A website, app, or skill moves to https://<new-name>.<org>.valet.run; the old address stops serving it and its name becomes available to another service in the same organization. An agent keeps its channels, which address it by id, and its URL moves with its name where the organization has agent URLs turned on. The architect agent cannot be renamed, and renaming an agent requires the organization to have one. A skill keeps its versions and the agents that hold it: a new version whose SKILL.md carries the new name is published, each holding agent picks the new name up on its own, and the answer names them. A skill under a well-known name, such as governance, keeps its name. A new skill name with two hyphens in a row is refused. holds two hyphens in a row. Returns the new name, the new URL for a website, app, or skill, and for an agent in an organization with agent URLs turned on, and for a skill the new version and the agents that hold it. Requires connecting a Valet account.

kind.description: The kind you believe the named service is, as a safeguard against renaming the wrong thing. Omit to rename whatever the name holds.

new_name.description: What the service is called from now on. Later calls name it this way, and its URL, where it has one, follows the new name.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: rename_service

held_by.description: Names of the agents that hold the renamed skill; each picks up the new name on its own. Absent for other kinds and for a skill no agent holds.

kind.description: Kind renamed: site, app, agent, or skill.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

url.description: Address the service is now served at. Absent for an agent in an organization whose agent URLs are not turned on, and for a skill whose route is not minted or moved yet.

version.description: Version of the release published for a renamed skill, whose SKILL.md carries the new name. Absent for other kinds.
